ROUTE-GEOMETRY DEFECT, not a data error. Payload flagged a 30.1x route-vs-sheet length ratio (sheet 18.45 km vs route-computed 553.78 km) as one of two rows v1 could source nothing for. Fetched P5862.geojson from the sibling routes repo (GOIT-GGIT-pipeline-routes/data/individual-routes/gas-pipelines/P5862.geojson, read-only, informational, never a ref) and computed haversine distance along its 5-vertex LineString: one vertex, [114.81473, 31.077466], sits ~270 km off-corridor from the other 4 tightly-clustered vertices (which alone haversine to ~23.5 km, close to the sheet's 18.45 km). Removing that single outlier vertex resolves the discrepancy. This is a digitization/data-entry defect in the route file (a stray coordinate, not a real 553 km pipe), not evidence the sheet's length is wrong. Recommend: Update/route-creation leg correct P5862.geojson by removing or replacing the outlier vertex; RouteAccuracy currently reads 'medium' and should be reassessed once the vertex is fixed. Never proposing the route edit directly per standing rule 6 -- flagging only.
